posts.title: Garment Factory
posts.description: My mum worked at the Dylex factory at 233 Carlaw Avenue in the 1980s. It is now a loft development catering to Toronto’s yuppie and artsy crowds. Its name, Garment Factory, pays tribute to its industrial past. Growing up, I had never visited the site. Chinese immigrants of my parents’ generation did not have many opportunities ...
